title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E7 — The Smothers Brothers, Melba Moore
Flips intros his invisible dog; a traveling salesman hits on Melba in the old days and the Smothers Bros join Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E9 — Dom DeLuise, Diahann Carroll, Kermit The Frog, The Muppets
Flip jokes about ugly fans; Diahann kisses Kermit; a drunk muppet has hiccups and Diahann stops by Flip’s gas station.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E10 — Tim Conway, Andy Griffith, The Clara Ward Singers
Flip & Andy are firemen; Tim sells luxury cars; Andy does his famous Romeo And Juliet monologue and Rev. Leroy preaches.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E12 — Tony Randall, Phyllis Diller, Billy Eckstine
Flip & Tony do a kiddie TV show; Phyllis Diller does stand-up in an outrageous outfit and Geraldine works at a boutique.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E19 — Black Fire
Guests include musical attractions Exuma, Taj Mahal, and actress Cicely Tyson, star of the motion picture, Sounder.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E20 — Elements
Guests include Tony Award-winning singer Linda Hopkins and the musical group Earth, Wind & Fire.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E16 — The Gospel Truth
Webster inadvertently books a gospel group instead of a rock band for a school party.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E17 — The Visitor
Webster's pen pal is an adult butler from England, and he visits to meet Webster in person before he dies.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E1 — Another Ballgame
After the untimely death of a young boy's parents, he is sent to live with his father's best friend.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E3 — Kathryn's Swan Song
Katherine wants to get some attention from Webster and she tries a few things. Meanwhile, Webster's friend is not getting much attention because her mom just had a baby, so she runs away and Webster hides her in his room.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E11 — Private School
The prospect of Tia's attending a prestigious prep school puts social pressure on Tia and financial pressure on Lisa.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E12 — Christmas
When a loan shark comes after Ray's father for a bad debt, the family comes to his rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E13 — Double Double Date
The twins find themselves in double trouble when they switch identities and Tia winds up with two dates for the same party.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E14 — Reality Really Bites
For her film class, Tia "spices up" her family documentary by throwing all sorts of monkey wrenches into their lives.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E15 — The Volunteers
While volunteering at a local retirement home, Tamera becomes determined to help a grumpy old man find happiness again.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E18 — It Takes Two
Kim’s mother, Nikki, is re-entering a journey she started 18 years ago. With Dee’s help, she will be completing her education to receive a high school diploma.
